name: fix-authority-done-material-overlap-audit
title: Fix Authority DONE material overlap audit submission
description: Lattice Authority Server DONE/enforce gate requires decision.materialOverlapAudit in the signed /v1/gates/evaluate envelope. Current Lattice CLI live smoke and Authority gate envelope omit the field, causing staging DONE preflight to fail with materialOverlapAudit.present=false. Fix only this correctness gap: carry the audit through CLI gate request contracts, include it before signing, preserve non-empty overlaps fail-closed, rebuild, and verify the targeted path.
